about: WILD LINK L6 (One World, the Camelot zone thread, 2026-11-17): the trail from the Snowy Pines' north end (Camelot, the Pass) up through the forest and the snowline to the Mountains' Ski Lodge. Its own room: joined to the Snowy Pines it would make a box 13 plots tall (the room-splitting rule's 12 x 12 box). The south end is Camelot's seam ow_h_m25_m10 (bake-camelot.js writes the Pines' side); the east end is the Mountains' seam ow_v_m22_m16 into the Ski Lodge's room, which the Mountains zone thread writes (site_prebuilt_shasta_ow_lodge).
label: THE TRAIL · THE PINES TO THE SKI LODGE
